```yaml
name: Build MobyRewards XCFramework

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-15

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Select Xcode
        run: |
          xcodebuild -version
          swift --version

      - name: Validate Swift Package
        run: |
          swift package describe
          swift package resolve

      - name: Build iOS device framework
        run: |
          xcodebuild archive \
            -scheme MobyRewards \
            -destination "generic/platform=iOS" \
            -archivePath "$RUNNER_TEMP/MobyRewards-iOS.xcarchive" \
            -derivedDataPath "$RUNNER_TEMP/DerivedData-iOS" \
            SKIP_INSTALL=NO \
            BUILD_LIBRARY_FOR_DISTRIBUTION=YES

      - name: Build iOS Simulator framework
        run: |
          xcodebuild archive \
            -scheme MobyRewards \
            -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" \
            -archivePath "$RUNNER_TEMP/MobyRewards-Simulator.xcarchive" \
            -derivedDataPath "$RUNNER_TEMP/DerivedData-Simulator" \
            SKIP_INSTALL=NO \
            BUILD_LIBRARY_FOR_DISTRIBUTION=YES

      - name: Create XCFramework
        run: |
          DEVICE="$RUNNER_TEMP/MobyRewards-iOS.xcarchive/Products/Library/Frameworks/MobyRewards.framework"
          SIMULATOR="$RUNNER_TEMP/MobyRewards-Simulator.xcarchive/Products/Library/Frameworks/MobyRewards.framework"

          test -d "$DEVICE"
          test -d "$SIMULATOR"

          xcodebuild -create-xcframework \
            -framework "$DEVICE" \
            -framework "$SIMULATOR" \
            -output "$RUNNER_TEMP/MobyRewards.xcframework"

      - name: Package and checksum
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent \
            MobyRewards.xcframework MobyRewards.xcframework.zip
          swift package compute-checksum MobyRewards.xcframework.zip \
            > MobyRewards.checksum
          cat MobyRewards.checksum

      - name: Upload build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: MobyRewards-XCFramework
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/MobyRewards.xcframework.zip
            ${{ runner.temp }}/MobyRewards.checksum
          if-no-files-found: error
```
